verdict.rationale: The registry offers only glancing self-service retrieval of a user's own data. An Online Account keeps a Transaction History where completed filings can be viewed and printed for up to 90 days, and copies of filings can be ordered. The Data and Image Subscriptions offering is bulk registry data, not a personal account export, and no format is documented for it. missing for 10: a complete account-data export, documented open/machine-readable formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), retention beyond 90 days, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of export.
